references.text: Moses spoke to all Israel; the same wording is used here as in Deuteronomy 32:45
Moses recited the words of this song to the entire assembly of Israel, serving as an introduction to the song that concludes at 32:45
A direct continuation where Moses urges the people to take to heart all the words he has spoken
The introduction to Deuteronomy where Moses began to speak all these words to Israel
Moses completed the work; a similar phrasing indicating that Moses finished a task given by the Lord
When he had spoken all these words, a similar concluding phrase after Moses' speech
